<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sigmafi/orders"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lock collateral in an order asking to borrow ERG or one token, repaid by a fixed height or a number of blocks after a lender fills it. Its batching fee is `sigmafi.bonds.batchingFeeNanoErg` unless the request sets a higher one. Cancel it with `POST /sigmafi/orders/{boxId}/cancel` while it is unfilled.
